tools.name: scrape_urls
tools.title: Scrape pages by URL
tools.summary: Fetch pages whose URLs you already have and return their content. No project is created.

tools.name: screenshot_url
tools.title: Take a screenshot of a page
tools.summary: Render one page in a browser and return a picture of it (JPEG, the visible window), with its title and what it cost.

tools.name: map_site
tools.title: Map a site's declared URLs
tools.summary: List the URLs a site declares in its sitemaps (found through robots.txt and the well-known paths, each index file walked to its children) without fetching any page.

tools.name: crawl_site
tools.title: Crawl a whole site once
tools.summary: Crawl a site once from a start URL, following links and the sitemap, and return the pages read. No project is set up.

tools.name: search_web
tools.title: Search the web
tools.summary: Search the web for a query and return the ranked results, each with its title, url and snippet: organic web results, no ads or AI summaries.

tools.name: run_agent
tools.title: Run a research agent
tools.summary: Hand a research question to an agent that searches the web, maps sites and reads pages on its own, then answers with the sources it used.

tools.name: continue_agent
tools.title: Continue a stopped agent run
tools.summary: Carry on an agent run that stopped at its credit limit (status credit_limit) with a new budget. It starts a new run on the same thread that resumes where the stopped one was, keeps the pages it read and answers in full.

tools.name: create_monitor
tools.title: Keep a search or question on a schedule
tools.summary: Keep a web search or an agent question and run it again on a schedule, each run compared with the last one that answered: new, dropped and moved results for a search, the answer's added, changed and removed values for a question.

tools.name: list_monitors
tools.title: List monitors and their runs
tools.summary: List the workspace's monitors -- searches and agent questions kept on a schedule -- each with its schedule, status, next run, this month's spend and what its last run found; or, with monitor_id, one monitor with its latest runs.

tools.name: pause_monitor
tools.title: Pause or resume a monitor
tools.summary: Pause a monitor so it makes no more scheduled runs, or resume it.

tools.name: get_monitor_rows
tools.title: Read a monitor's records
tools.summary: Read the records an agent monitor follows -- one per item its answer lists, e.g. each plan of a pricing page -- as they stand, with the page each value was read on; and, with changes=true, what moved: records added, a column changed (before and after), records gone.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.title: List all projects
tools.summary: List every project in the workspace, the sites it watches over time, each with its id, name, host, schedule, page count, coverage, last run and status; and the workspace's plan and the credits it has left.

tools.name: get_project
tools.title: Get a project, or the settings
tools.summary: Read one project in full, or with no project_id the settings any project can take.

tools.name: create_project
tools.title: Create a watched project
tools.summary: Create a project: a site MeshArc re-crawls on a schedule, comparing each run with the last to record pages added, modified and removed.

tools.name: update_project
tools.title: Update a project's settings
tools.summary: Change a project's name, schedule or settings, its webhook among them, and send the webhook a test.

tools.name: delete_project
tools.title: Delete a project
tools.summary: Delete a project for good, with everything its runs stored.

tools.name: archive_project
tools.title: Archive a project
tools.summary: Archive a project: it stops running, no longer counts toward the plan's projects, and is deleted for good after 30 days unless someone restores it in the MeshArc app.

tools.name: start_run
tools.title: Start a project run now
tools.summary: Crawl a project's site now with its saved settings, or re-read only the pages you list. The run is compared with the one before it.

tools.name: list_runs
tools.title: List a project's runs
tools.summary: List a project's runs, newest first, with each run's id, status, trigger, pages read and pages changed.

tools.name: list_pages
tools.title: List, search or read a run's pages
tools.summary: List the pages a project run stored; with q, find the pages whose text or markup matches; with url, read one page in full, with its versions across runs.

tools.name: get_changes
tools.title: Get what changed in a run
tools.summary: Report what changed in a project run against the run just before it, or against any run you name: pages added, modified and removed, field changes, and coverage.

tools.name: get_job
tools.title: Follow a long-running job
tools.summary: Check on a crawl, run, batch, web search or agent run a tool handed back as a job, and return its result once finished.

tools.name: cancel_job
tools.title: Cancel a running job
tools.summary: Stop a crawl, run, batch or agent run that is still going.
